name: cssints
description: CSS in TypeScript: typed css.* calls compiled to atomic CSS at build time (a Vite plugin)

scripts.test: cd test && node run.mjs fixtures/risk*.ts fixtures/typed*.ts fixtures/tokens-typed.ts fixtures/tokens-named.ts fixtures/tokens-use.ts fixtures/tokens-style.ts fixtures/helper-use.ts fixtures/cv.ts fixtures/order.ts fixtures/conditions.ts fixtures/cond-use.ts fixtures/math.ts fixtures/unreached.ts fixtures/cv-top.ts && node run.mjs fixtures/unreached.ts | grep -q 'off = false && "_' && node run.mjs fixtures/unreached.ts | grep -q 'gap > 9 ? "_' && node run.mjs fixtures/runtime-arg.ts | grep -q 'must be known at build time: .n. is not defined' && ! node run.mjs fixtures/invalid.ts > /dev/null && node run.mjs fixtures/no-attribute.ts | grep -q "without the attribute" && node run.mjs fixtures/chain-error.ts | grep -q "has no .padding()" && node run.mjs fixtures/cv-string.ts | grep -q "CSS strings are gone" && node run.mjs fixtures/cond-cap.ts | grep -q "at most 4 conditions" && node run.mjs fixtures/cond-query.ts | grep -q "@media: unexpected" && node run.mjs fixtures/math-bad.ts | grep -q "cannot add length and time" && node run.mjs fixtures/token-relative.ts | grep -q "depends on the font size" && node run.mjs fixtures/token-bad.ts | grep -q "initial value \"blu\" is not a <color>" && node run.mjs fixtures/token-misuse.ts | grep -q "is checked as " && node contexts.mjs && node conditions.mjs && node tokens.mjs && node themes.mjs && node runtime.mjs && node map-check.mjs && node sheet.mjs && node docs.mjs && node spec/race.mjs && cd hmr && node hmr.mjs && ORDER=button-first node hmr.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsgo -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.json --format pretty
